summary: Ukrainian forces faced significant missile and drone attacks on Kyiv, including 4 ballistic missiles and 146 drones. Ukraine announced plans to double annual drone production. Protests erupted against Defense Minister Fedorov's dismissal.
key_points: Ukrainian forces repelled an attack on Kyiv involving 4 ballistic missiles and 146 drones (Source: @kpszsu/68667).
Ukraine plans to double annual drone production to 20 million, per Zelensky (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31644).
Protests against Fedorov's dismissal occurred in Kyiv, Lviv, and Dnepropetrovsk (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31662).
Russian forces struck Ukrainian positions in Chernihiv, Dnipropetrovsk, and Kyiv with ballistic missiles and drones (Source: @eRadarrua/101226, @kpszsu/68666).
Ukrainian military reported 1,450 daily losses from Russian actions (Source: @tass_agency/385512).
Reactive Shahed drones targeted Odesa and other regions (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69089).
Ukrainian military claimed destruction of 802 Ukrainian drones and 8 guided bombs by Russian PVO (Source: @tass_agency/385513).

sections.threat_assessment: The increased frequency of ballistic missile and drone attacks on Kyiv and other regions indicates a heightened escalation in the conflict. Russia's use of long-range missiles and Shahed drones suggests a strategic effort to overwhelm Ukrainian defenses. Ukraine's drone production surge may offset losses but requires sustained international support.
sections.regional_response: International partners are likely to increase military aid to Ukraine, particularly in drone and missile defense systems. Domestic protests against Fedorov's dismissal may pressure political leadership to stabilize military command. Russia's continued strikes on civilian infrastructure could provoke further international condemnation.
sections.intelligence_notes: The political maneuvering between Syrsky and Fedorov highlights internal instability in Ukraine's defense leadership. Russia's targeting of Kyiv and other regions suggests a focus on psychological and material pressure. Ukraine's drone production capacity could become a decisive factor if sustained.
